excerpts.author: markodayan
excerpts.content:
Hi, this is my 6th update of the fellowship where I am working on rollup economics 🙂 
- Synced a couple of nodes (L1 CC and EC, Optimism replica)
- Wrote some scraping services to grab and parse Optimism and Arbitrum sequencer batch transactions on Ethereum
- Getting ready to set up a web server for other members working on this project to access publication fee data for analysis
